settings.title: Settings
settings.language.label: Admin language
settings.language.help: Default language for the admin interface. Staff can override it for themselves.
settings.siteTitle.label: Site title
settings.siteTitle.help: Shown as the name of the publication.
settings.siteDescription.label: Site description
settings.siteDescription.help: One line, used in feeds and meta tags.
settings.siteUrl.label: Site URL
settings.siteUrl.help: Absolute links in the Content API are built from this. Leave blank to fall back to KAKU_URL.
settings.timezone.label: Timezone
settings.timezone.help: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Tokyo. Publish times are read in this zone.
settings.defaultVisibility.label: Default post visibility
settings.postsPerPage.label: Posts per page
settings.postsPerPage.help: Page size for the Content API, between 1 and 100.
settings.footerText.label: Footer line
settings.footerText.help: Copyright or credit shown at the foot of the site.
settings.error.options: Choose one of the listed options.
settings.error.url: Must be an absolute http:// or https:// URL.
settings.error.timezone: Unknown timezone. Use an IANA name like UTC or Asia/Tokyo.
settings.error.perPage: Must be a whole number between 1 and 100.
settings.env.title: Environment
settings.env.note: Read-only. These come from the KAKU_* environment variables this process started with.
settings.backup.title: Database backup
settings.backup.disabledAfter: to enable scheduled and manual backups.
settings.backup.scheduleAfter: every 24 hours; the seven most recent are kept.
settings.backup.failed: Backup failed. Check the server log.
